g.text: Your Outlook account: mail, scheduled sends, contacts and calendar. Bare 'co outlook' shows the
│ send Send an email from your Outlook account, now or scheduled with --at. │
│ reply Reply to an email (threaded), now or scheduled with --at. │
│ inbox List recent emails in your Outlook inbox. │
│ read Show one email's body without changing its unread state. │
│ download Save an email's attachments to disk. │
│ sent List recently sent Outlook emails. │
│ scheduled List emails waiting for scheduled delivery. │
│ cancel Cancel a scheduled email before it goes out. │
│ contact Add, list, and search Outlook contacts. │
│ calendar Your Outlook calendar: events, Teams meetings, free slots. Bare 'co outlook calendar' │
Send an email from your Outlook account, now or scheduled with --at.
│ * to <str> Recipient email address (comma-separated for multiple) [required] │
│ * message <str> Body (plain text, or '-' to read from stdin) [required] │
│ --at <str> Schedule delivery: +30m, +2h, or UTC ISO time (2026-07-06T15:30:00Z); │
│ cancel before it goes out with co outlook cancel <#> │
Examples: co outlook send a@b.com "Hi" "Quick note" | cat body.txt | co outlook send a@b.com
Usage: python -m connectonion.cli.main outlook calendar [OPTIONS] COMMAND
Your Outlook calendar: events, Teams meetings, free slots. Bare 'co outlook calendar' lists
│ list List upcoming events with stable event IDs (not row numbers). │
│ read Read one event by ID. │
│ meetings Read upcoming events that have attendees. │
│ free Find free slots between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC on one day. │
│ create Create an event. Previews until --yes. │
│ teams Create an event with a Microsoft Teams meeting link. Previews until --yes. │
│ update Update the supplied fields; omitted fields are preserved. Previews until --yes. │
│ delete Delete an event by its stable ID, never by a listing number. Previews until --yes. │
Next: co outlook calendar create 'Design review' 2026-09-10T20:00:00+10:00 2026-09-10T21:00:00+10:00
